statement: Control-to-scenario mapping for the 0.5.0rc2 CLI product. A mapping records which implemented control a scenario exercises and its executed outcome. No category or technique is declared fully accepted.

C-AUTH.name: Credential digests with tenant-bound route grants

C-PEER.name: Linux SO_PEERCRED peer binding before payload read

C-SENS.name: Trusted sensitivity classification, route clearance and durable agent taint

C-VAULT.name: Model-default scoped vault tokenization with explicit operator exceptions

C-RETR.name: Per-document retrieval authorization from Guard-owned records

C-GROUND.name: Citation provenance with optional strict source-extractive response contract

C-OUTCOME.name: Durable duplicate suppression with time-bound retention

C-AUDIT.name: Encrypted chained audit with archives and allowlisted export

C-EGRESS.name: Network-less Guard with independent allowlisting egress proxy

C-ADMIT.name: Component hash pin plus declared-capability static check

C-BUDGET.name: Shared workflow budgets with optional encrypted single-host recovery

C-LABEL.name: Workflow-wide sticky labels across artifacts and handoffs

C-PROVIDER.name: Text-only provider request allowlist (no provider-side URL fetch, hosted tools, storage or media)

C-DOMAIN.name: Backend identity for round-trip labels: canonical host names and declared data domains

C-AI.name: Configured action-bound AI assessment with deterministic precedence and actor-scoped context (synthetic wiring evidence)
C-AI.implementation: security_assessment.ChatSecurityAnalyzer, ai_security.AISecurityControl, security_context.SecurityHistoryStore, host internal inspection boundary

LLM01:2026.residual_risk: Injected text cannot grant tools, identities or task scope in tested boundaries; semantic hijack of already-permitted actions and live-model robustness are not established. AI-engine scenarios use fixed synthetic assessments to validate enforcement wiring; live-model detection accuracy and attack robustness are not established.

LLM02:2026.residual_risk: Detected patterns, configured field rules, declared context and Guard-observed data are controlled; undeclared unlabelled confidential prose that never passed through Guard is not recognized. Host names that reach one backend share labels only when declared as one data_domain; undeclared DNS-level aliases are not discovered (confirmed gap). Provider features enabled outside the request (for example a model with built-in browsing) are the operator's choice. AI-engine scenarios use fixed synthetic assessments to validate enforcement wiring; live-model detection accuracy and attack robustness are not established.

LLM03:2026.residual_risk: Configured grants, boundaries and approvals tested; downstream business authorization remains the connector's responsibility.

LLM04:2026.residual_risk: Replacement and undeclared capabilities are denied; a correctly pinned component that misuses declared capabilities is not classified (confirmed gap).

LLM05:2026.residual_risk: Scope limitation: Guard has no access to training data or model weights. Model identity is pinned by configuration and retrieval content comes only from operator-ingested records; poisoned answers are not detected (confirmed gap).

LLM06:2026.residual_risk: Shared budgets and per-UID admission (container evidence) tested; same-UID legacy mode remains vulnerable (confirmed gap); host-level CPU/memory exhaustion needs operator limits. AI-engine scenarios use fixed synthetic assessments to validate enforcement wiring; live-model detection accuracy and attack robustness are not established.

LLM07:2026.residual_risk: Citation mode does not prove semantic support (confirmed gap). Optional extractive mode rejects added prose and enforces authorized verbatim spans in a strict format; source truth and misleading span selection/concatenation remain unverified.

LLM08:2026.residual_risk: Declared context is withheld including common obfuscations; paraphrase and undeclared context are missed (confirmed gaps).

LLM09:2026.residual_risk: The supported retrieval integrations authorize every document from trusted records; generic tool connectors used for retrieval receive no document ACLs (confirmed gap).

LLM10:2026.residual_risk: No implicit executor; Guard egress is allowlisted. Sink-specific validation of generated content remains the connector's responsibility.

ASI01:2026.residual_risk: Retrieved or memorized instructions cannot redefine authority; hijack within the permitted task remains possible. AI-engine scenarios use fixed synthetic assessments to validate enforcement wiring; live-model detection accuracy and attack robustness are not established.

ASI02:2026.residual_risk: Unknown tools, escalation, out-of-boundary arguments and provider-side tool or fetch fields are denied; per-resource business policy must be configured.

ASI03:2026.residual_risk: Forged, stolen-from-another-UID and revoked identities denied (peer binding in container evidence); compromise of the Guard host or bootstrap is out of scope. AI-engine scenarios use fixed synthetic assessments to validate enforcement wiring; live-model detection accuracy and attack robustness are not established.

ASI04:2026.residual_risk: As LLM04; MCP/skill package scanning is not provided.

ASI05:2026.residual_risk: No implicit code execution route; container isolation evidence is platform-scoped and kernel escape is not ruled out.

ASI06:2026.residual_risk: Memory writes are untrusted and cannot grant authority; retrieval identity is never caller-supplied; semantic poisoning detection is not provided.

ASI07:2026.residual_risk: In-coordinator handoffs, replay and label propagation tested; network agent-to-agent messaging is unsupported. AI-engine scenarios use fixed synthetic assessments to validate enforcement wiring; live-model detection accuracy and attack robustness are not established.

ASI08:2026.residual_risk: Inspection outages deny before side effects; uncertain outcomes are never replayed; single-host only, no HA. AI-engine scenarios use fixed synthetic assessments to validate enforcement wiring; live-model detection accuracy and attack robustness are not established.

ASI09:2026.residual_risk: Substituted, replayed, cross-tenant and agent self-approvals rejected; human social-engineering resistance is not established.

ASI10:2026.residual_risk: Revocation stops new work and cancels in-flight work; side effects already performed are not rolled back.

AML.T0029.note: Legacy same-UID starvation is a confirmed gap; peer-bound fairness is container evidence.

AML.T0018.note: Scope limitation: no model-weight access; model identity pinned by configuration only.
